text: Resource Exploration Engineering is an applied discipline based on earth sciences, focusing on the exploration, evaluation and development of mineral resources (such as oil, coal, metal ores, groundwater, etc.). It combines theories such as geology, geophysics, and geochemistry, and employs techniques like drilling, geophysical exploration, and geochemical exploration to discover the distribution patterns of resources, assess resource reserves and mining value, providing scientific basis for the sustainable utilization of natural resources by humans. It is the core bridge connecting basic geological research and the resource development industry.
